ayahOccurrences.text: إِنَّمَا ٱلصَّدَقَٰتُ لِلْفُقَرَآءِ وَٱلْمَسَٰكِينِ وَٱلْعَٰمِلِينَ عَلَيْهَا وَٱلْمُؤَلَّفَةِ قُلُوبُهُمْ وَفِى ٱلرِّقَابِ وَٱلْغَٰرِمِينَ وَفِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱبْنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ ۖ فَرِيضَةً مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ

ayahOccurrences.text: وَمِنَ ٱلْأَعْرَابِ مَن يَتَّخِذُ مَا يُنفِقُ مَغْرَمًا وَيَتَرَبَّصُ بِكُمُ ٱلدَّوَآئِرَ ۚ عَلَيْهِمْ دَآئِرَةُ ٱلسَّوْءِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ

ayahOccurrences.text: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا ٱصْرِفْ ٱصْرِفْ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَنَّمَ ۖ إِنَّ عَذَابَهَا كَانَ غَرَامًا

ayahOccurrences.text: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ أَجْرًا فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍ مُّثْقَلُونَ

lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: وَٱلْغَٰرِمِينَ is in the derivative form: غارِمين
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
غ/ر/م   gh–r–m loss, financial liability 1 takes upon oneself, to be in debt
; lasting torment, aching love, fondness, heart; (of heat) scorching; opponent.

Of this root, 4 forms occur 6 times in the Qur’an:
غارِمين ghārimın 1 time; غَراماٌ gharāman 1 time; مَغْرَم maghram 3 times and مُغْرَمون mughramūn 1 time.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
غارِمين ghārimın [pl. of act. part. غارِم ghārim] debtors, those incurring debts as a result of helping others

(9:60) إِِنَّمَا‏ ‏الصَّدَقَاتُ‏ لِلْفُقَرَاءِ ... وَالْغَارِمِينَ ...‏] alms are only for the poor […] and the ones who incur debt in their helping of others and in the way of God.

entries.label: غارِمين
entries.definitionHtml:
غارِمين ghārimın [pl. of act. part. غارِم ghārim] debtors, those incurring debts as a result of helping others

(9:60) إِِنَّمَا‏ ‏الصَّدَقَاتُ‏ لِلْفُقَرَاءِ ... وَالْغَارِمِينَ ...‏] alms are only for the poor […] and the ones who incur debt in their helping of others and in the way of God.

entries.label: غَراما
entries.definitionHtml:
غَراما gharāman [v. n./n.] constant severe [torment], clinging, lasting

(25:65) رَبَّنَا‏ ‏اصْرِفْ‏ ‏عَنَّا‏ ‏عَذَابَ‏ ‏جَهَنَّمَ‏ ‏إِنَّ‏ ‏عَذَابَهَا‏ ‏كَانَ ‏‏غَرَامًا our Lord, turn away from us the chastisement of Hell, for its chastisement is a dreadful, lasting anguish.

entries.label: مَغْرَم
entries.definitionHtml:
مَغْرَم maghram [n./v. n.] a liability, particularly financial, incurred not as a result of one’s own action; unjust fine or penalty, loss, debt unjustly incurred, imposition

(9:98) وَمِنَ‏ ‏الأَعْرَابِ‏ ‏مَنْ‏ ‏يَتَّخِذُ‏ ‏مَا يُنْفِقُ‏ ‏مَغْرَمًا ‏‏and of the desert Arabs are those who consider what they spend [in the cause of God] as a financial imposition.

entries.label: مُغْرَمون
entries.definitionHtml:
مُغْرَمون mughramūn [pl. of quasi‐pass. part. مُغْرَم mughram] tormented, left with heavy loss/debt

(56:66) إِنَّا‏ ‏لَمُغْرَمُونَ‏ We are burdened with the debt [over what we have spent] (or, we are faced with destruction [because of the loss of our livelihood]).
